info.title: KM Code Craft Radiology – workplace API
info.description: Interface of the radiology workplace. Not for primary diagnosis. Every response carries x-correlation-id; quote it when reporting a problem. Access is limited to the sites and departments of the caller. Write operations use optimistic concurrency (expectedVersion).
